synthesis:
The Scout onboarding (set-password) email's sign-off uses ->salutation('Thanks,
Insight LPR Team') inside a Notification MailMessage builder. Laravel's default markdown notification template (email.blade.php) echoes {{ $salutation }} through Blade's EncodedHtmlString, which runs htmlspecialchars() on the string BEFORE CommonMark parses it, so the literal
is escaped and displayed as visible text. Fix: use CommonMark's hard-line-break syntax (two trailing spaces + \n), which survives the escape step and is converted to a real line break by the markdown renderer in BOTH the HTML and plain-text mail parts.

scope.summary:
One-line change in ScoutOnboardingNotification::toMail() replacing the raw
in ->salutation() with a markdown hard break, plus a focused regression test.

proposed_changes.change:
Replace ->salutation('Thanks,
Insight LPR Team') with ->salutation("Thanks, \nInsight LPR Team") (two trailing spaces + newline = markdown hard break).
proposed_changes.reason: email.blade.php echoes $salutation via {{ }} (EncodedHtmlString -> htmlspecialchars) before CommonMark parses it, so embedded raw HTML is escaped to literal text. A markdown hard break is native markdown processed after the escape step, so it renders a real line break in HTML and preserves two lines in the plain-text fallback.

out_of_scope:
Other notifications/mailables — sweep found no other MailMessage-builder call sites; all other
usages live in static Blade markdown views (Mailable::markdown, html_input=ALLOW) and are safe.
Changing EncodedHtmlString escaping or CommonMark config (intentional XSS protection).
Subject, button text/URL, or link TTL (AC-2 requires unchanged).

questions.q: Is a markdown hard break the correct fix vs HtmlString/PHP_EOL?
questions.answer: Markdown hard break (two spaces + \n) is the only option correct in BOTH parts. tinker showed plain \n = unreliable soft break; HtmlString = correct HTML but glues plain-text lines together ('Thanks,Insight LPR Team').

questions.q: Will Pint/editorconfig strip the two trailing spaces?
questions.answer: No — the spaces are inside a PHP string literal on one physical line, not trailing whitespace of a source line, so trim_trailing_whitespace/Pint leave them.

notes: Notification is dispatched from 3 call sites (ScoutUsersResource.php:405, EditScoutUser.php:76 and :115); all share the single salutation source, so the centralized fix covers all.

Existing sibling notification test convention: tests/Feature/Mail/Scout/OneTimePasswordNotificationTest.php — mirror it (render the notification's MailMessage, assert on rendered content). Place the new test in tests/Feature/Mail/Scout/.
Root cause is upstream, intentional: EncodedHtmlString::toHtml() htmlspecialchars-escapes {{ }} echoes in the default notification template — do not modify.

Static blade markdown views (SendOneTimePassword, invites, pro/*) embed
in source and render correctly (html_input=ALLOW) — safe, unaffected.
